out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed 2026 permit not on site.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine, Thermometers
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device for the (wash/rinse/sanitizing) tank of the warewashing machine is (missing/not operating.) observed no test kit to verify temperature of heat sanitizing dish machine
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine shall be equipped with a temperature measuring device that indicates the temperature of the water in each wash and rinse tank and as the water enters the hot water sanitizing final rinse manifold or in the chemical sanitizing solution tank.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. No test kit for heat sanitizing dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH, or QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. CDI Ehs provided. PIC order online thermal stickers for dish machine, and chemical test kits.
